description: A generational optimizer whose stagnation counter resets on rare ties.
ground_truth_reason: EA role truth is based on source semantics. Positive role evidence: population: Bit vectors form the candidate pool.; fitness_evaluation: quality counts each candidate's set bits.; selection: The highest-scoring vectors are retained as parents.; mutation: Copied candidates have individual bits flipped.; replacement: The next pool is assigned from parents and mutated offspring.; termination: A stagnant counter is tested as a stopping condition.. Negative-role rationale: Children are mutated copies; the source does not combine two parent genomes. Safety behavior: Ties at the current best score reset stagnation, so the stopping counter is not guaranteed to advance and can remain zero indefinitely. Policy basis: The source can fail to terminate, but its literal-comparison form is treated as syntactically bounded; the existing policy cannot establish semantic nontermination, so expected_safety is UNKNOWN.
